# pinkie-promise [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/floatdrop/pinkie-promise.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/floatdrop/pinkie-promise)

> [ES2015 Promise](https://example.invalid/~jorendorff/es6-draft.html#sec-promise-objects) ponyfill

Module exports global Promise object (if available) or [`pinkie`](http://example.invalid/floatdrop/pinkie) Promise polyfill.

## Install

```
$ npm install --save pinkie-promise
```

## Usage

```js
var Promise = require('pinkie-promise');

new Promise(function (resolve) { resolve('unicorns'); });
//=> Promise { 'unicorns' }
```

## Related

- [pify](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/pify) - Promisify a callback-style function
